product.title: Lotus Cove Mat in Tube
product.body_html:
Serene, colorful, and beautifully layered, the Lotus Cove Mat brings the tranquil beauty of a lotus pond to your mahjong table. Soft aquatic hues mingle with warm pinks and fresh greens, creating a design that feels peaceful yet full of personality.

Graceful koi swim among oversized lotus blossoms and lily pads, while delicate fish and botanical details add movement throughout the design. A scalloped pink frame creates a striking focal point, complemented by a soft aqua border with subtle bamboo-inspired details. The result is a fresh, artful mat that feels both whimsical and sophisticated.

With its calming palette and intricate pond-inspired artwork, the Lotus Cove Mat creates a beautiful setting for gathering around the table.

Why You’ll Love It

• Pond-inspired artwork featuring koi, lotus blossoms, lily pads, and delicate fish
• Fresh palette of soft pink, aqua, green, and cream
• Layered borders and botanical details add depth and visual interest
• Instructional layout printed directly on the mat for easy gameplay
• Smooth neoprene surface helps keep tiles in place
• Stitched border for a polished, durable finish

Details

• Mat Dimensions: 33" x 33"
• Material: Neoprene with stitched border

Storage

• Comes rolled in a reusable, sleek storage tube
• Tube Dimensions: 33.5" long x 2 3/4" wide
• Perfect for stylish storage and effortless travel
